notes.subject: שלמי אמוני ישראל
notes.rationale: Samting i stap: 'mi bilong ol man i gat pis na bilip' o 'mi — ol man i gat pis na bilip — bilong Yisrael' (em i tok bilong siti olgeta, no bilong wanpela meri tasol)

notes.subject: swarap
notes.rationale: בלע em i swarap — graun o abus i swarapim samting; 'bagarapim' bai lusim piksa bilong maot

notes.subject: to Joab
notes.rationale: Meri i kotim Yoav direktpli long tok bilong em

translation: Mi bilong ol man i gat pis na bilip long Yisrael; yu painim long kilim siti, em i mama bilong kantri long Yisrael; bilong wanem yu laik swarap olgeta samting Yahwe i wokim long givim long ol?

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i gat pis
olgeta samting i givim long ol
